# Assets · App icons

5 files under `assets/App icons/`, held in the artifact’s asset store: fetch one with the Artifact tool’s `read`, the id below as `path` (they are not files beside the page — a read by file path fails), then upload it to your own artifact as an asset (`publish`, `asset:true`; or `upload_asset`, where your tool lists that); an SVG may also be inlined. Copy assets, never approximate them.

## Use

```html
<img src="<the url the asset upload returned for android-chrome-512x512.png>" alt="…">
```

## Usage notes

Favicon and home-screen artwork: a pair of sunburst congas on a transparent ground, linked from `Layout.astro` and `site.webmanifest`.

- `favicon-16x16.png`, `favicon-32x32.png`: browser tab icons.
- `apple-touch-icon.png`: 180 × 180, iOS home screen.
- `android-chrome-192x192.png`, `android-chrome-512x512.png`: Android and PWA icons from the web manifest.
